mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decline (3 consecutive monthly decreases).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it indicates a tightening labor market that typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity across both consumer and business sectors, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which typically supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend (3 consecutive monthly increases).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2050 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing, which typically boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 2050.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS rising above 134,000 thousand) combined with a stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 3.5%) signals robust economic growth and low inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 134000 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0%), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflationary pressures and potential central bank tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.
